title: Zesty American Tofu Pie
description: A mustardy, low-calorie tofu pie with a crispy shortcrust crust, perfect for adventurous American dinner.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: soak in brine (1 tsp salt in 1 cup water) 15 min, then press 30 min

instructions: Prepare a brine by dissolving 1 tsp salt in 1 cup water, soak tofu for 15 minutes, then press it for 30 minutes to remove excess liquid.
Cut the pressed tofu into 1 cm cubes and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté the minced shallot until translucent.
Add garlic powder, smoked paprika, thyme, and black pepper; cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the cubed tofu, Dijon mustard, whole grain mustard, soy sauce, and vegetable broth; simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Roll out the pastry on parchment paper, fit it into a 9-inch pie dish, and prick the bottom with a fork.
Fill the pastry crust with the tofu mixture and cover with the remaining pastry or leave open for a crisp top.
Bake for 25 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from oven, let cool for 5 minutes, then slice and serve.
